row.notes: Builds the second 3D driver model of the MyTeam driver market / contract comparison screen. Returns early if +0x2a80 is null; resolves the selected VM list node (+0x6d8), finds the matching market entry in the vector at +0x2558..+0x2560 (stride 0xf20, node at entry+8), reads driver ids entry+0xe98/+0xe9c and looks up the entrant in (entry+0xe90)+0x2e0 (stride 0x88) for the team id at +0x58, picks a random name string via LCG 0x343fd/0x269ec3 on (+0x2d70)+0x188, then Game_FrontendSceneManager_FindOrCreateNewCustomDriver(+0x2d58, slot +0x2d44) and Game_FrontendSceneManager_SetupCustomDriver. If +0x2dc0==0 uses scene node Driver2 with pose_08_idle (kind 4); else DriverMarketDriver2 with pose_08_idle (kind 3/7) when the bool VM var at +0x2a00 is true, otherwise DriverRatings with pose_07_idle (kind 3). Good hook to swap pose or scene node.
